snippet.title: Desert Race Adventures - Official Trailer
snippet.description: Get a look at Desert Race Adventures in this trailer for the upcoming strategic rally adventure game with a roguelike twist. Set out on a race across Europe and Africa. Manage your team, vehicle and supplies strategically as you navigate the treacherous terrain. Each challenge on the road forces difficult decisions that impact your journey. Lead your pilot team to victory, and finish with a high score! Or try, fail, and try again. Desert Race Adventures will be available in summer 2025 on PC (Steam), with Nintendo Switch soon after.
